ops.title: Reduce repeated native activity walks in displaced cleanup
ops.description: Owner: /root/ccx_targeted_stack_io. Source-confirmed follow-up independent of PR612: each native Guard lists UID PIDs and inspects cwd/threadcwd/FDs/argv; successful displaced logical retirement runs four independent Guard walks (tree+admin, before/after watcher retirement), physical resume runs six before later admission. No actualhost cost measured or claimed. Evidence ccx-retirement-native-probe-multiplicity.json @801e640d. Next executable step: CI-only fakeGuard call-count fixture and security design for one process observation covering both roots at each fresh checkpoint; no across-request cache, no TTL, no weakening unknown/holder/start/ancestry/UID/watcher/evidence contracts. Security-sensitive implementation route must be assigned before edits; keep PR612 ship independent and physical cleanup paused.

ops.text: CI proves current exact activity walk counts and preserved holder/unknown/error semantics for both captured roots
Reviewed implementation shares only fresh per-checkpoint native process observations; required CI green and public installed helper
After explicit runtime grant, actual inactive cleanup admission materially reduces native calls/CPU without touching active sessions or resuming unauthorized physical deletion
